scope: Actual Chromium rendering of the production Canvas renderer and content modules in a dedicated canvas-only fixture document. This complements the separate real-game UI and touch acceptance reports.

method.maps: Render each of all 11 registered levels using fresh serializable fixture states, the real level terrain/weather/palette definitions, all six plant styles and representative enemies; required encounters include their leader/BOSS sprites and bars.
method.skills: Render blast, gale, cart, horse and laser; also render the retained trench/frost/poison terrain and skill aiming geometry.
method.immutability: Compare JSON.stringify(state) immediately before and after renderer.render for every map. All 11 states remain identical.
method.coordinateRoundTrip: Convert the gardener world position to CSS screen coordinates and back using the renderer camera. All errors are zero.
method.contextRecovery: Dispatch contextlost and contextrestored canvas DOM events, check renderer.contextLost transitions, and redraw successfully after cached artwork is released. Events are synthetic; this does not force an operating-system GPU reset.
method.consoleErrors: Console messages were not separately collected by this canvas-only fixture; real-game browser acceptance records console errors independently.

artifacts.description: Opening courtyard with the six plant styles, pet, bullets and hazard geometry.
Final garden with all six plant styles, pet, BOSS phase/health display, terrain and lightning telegraph.
